allocation_scope: Python/NumPy allocations during the same build only, including retained returned outputs; not total process RSS or all Pillow/native allocations. The borrowed input components/images are prepared before tracing.
historical_linkage: Complete historical PixelStrokeEngine is installed under its public module name for the actual DrawBot and PixelAccuracyEngine nested imports. Other modules are shared unchanged between both sides.
method: One warm pair, 6 balanced AB/BA pairs, then separate before/after tracemalloc probes. Complete outputs checked on every warm, counted, timed and traced invocation.
timing_scope: Entire scheduler or entire public make_plan call; inputs prepared before timing. No cached plan. Fingerprinting, independent raster verification and owned-image cleanup are outside timing.
work_scope: Actual sorted-list pop shifts and actual bounded-list C-pop shifts; profiling/cost-call counting is outside all timing/tracing.
